help.masterStep1Desc: Go to "Company Settings" to update your logo and company details.
help.masterStep2Desc: Go to "Team Management" -> tap "Add User" to create a Manager/Driver. To delete, tap the red trash can icon next to their name.
help.masterStep3Desc: Go to "Team Management" -> tap the Key icon next to a user's name -> type a new password and save.
help.masterStep4Desc: Go to "Team Management" -> tap the Loudspeaker icon at the top -> enter your message and select "All Users".
help.masterStep5Desc: Go to either Team or Leaderboard page to see a summary of your driver's Scores and who needs a Tune-Up.
help.masterStep6Desc: Go to the Leaderboard -> click "Export" to download a full Excel report of all safety scores.
help.managerStep1Desc: Go to "Team Management" -> tap "Add User" -> select "Driver" role and their vehicle type -> share the password with them.
help.managerStep2Desc: Go to either Team or Leaderboard page to see a summary of your driver's Scores and who needs a Tune-Up.
help.managerStep3: How to Send a Normal Notification
help.managerStep3Desc: Go to "Team Management" -> tap the Bell icon next to a specific driver's name -> send them a direct message.
help.managerStep4Desc: Go to the Leaderboard -> click "Export" to download a full Excel report of your team's safety scores.
help.driverStep1Desc: Go to "Quiz" -> click "Start Quiz (Live)" to answer questions that affect your safety score.
help.driverStep2Desc: Go to "Quiz" -> click "Practice Mode" to practice questions without affecting your score.
help.driverStep3Desc: Go to "Leaderboard" -> look at "All Time" views to see your rank among peers.
help.driverStep4Desc: Go to "Notifications" (Bell icon at the bottom tab) -> click on unread alerts to view assigned tasks or broadcast messages.
help.driverStep5Desc: Go to "Profile" -> click on your Profile Details card to update your region or vehicle type.
